title: EU Policy & Outreach Partnership Technical Assistance Programme in Mexico & Central America (2021-2025)
executive_summary: The EU Policy & Outreach Partnership Technical Assistance Programme (2021-2025), implemented by the Organization of Ibero-American States and funded by the European Union, aims to strengthen EU public diplomacy and partnerships in Mexico and Central America. The initiative focuses on enhancing the EU’s engagement with key stakeholders—including business leaders, policymakers, influencers, and civil society—through strategic outreach, cultural activities, and policy dialogue. Over its 47-month duration, the programme targets more than 1,000 direct beneficiaries and aligns with SDG 17 (Partnerships). Expected outcomes include increased visibility of EU priorities, deeper mutual understanding, and a consolidated stakeholder network. Activities encompass forums on democracy and digital transformation, cultural events, workshops, and academic exchanges, all designed to foster trust and project the EU as a value-driven global actor in the region.
characteristics: EU-funded technical assistance programme (2021-2025) implemented by OEI to strengthen EU public-diplomacy and partnerships in Mexico and Central America.
Aims to support EU policy implementation by enhancing engagement with business, decision-makers, influencers, and civil society through strategic outreach and cultural activities.
Focuses on increasing EU visibility, building mutual trust, and consolidating stakeholder networks for sustained policy dialogue.
Activities include forums on key themes, cultural events, workshops, and academic exchanges, aligned with SDG 17 (Partnerships).
practical_applications: Implementation of the EU Policy & Outreach Partnership - Technical Assistance Programme in Mexico & Central America (2021-2025), funded by the European Union and implemented by the Organization of Ibero-American States (OEI), to strengthen EU public-diplomacy outreach and partnerships in the region.
Organization of forums on democracy, digital transformation, climate, and inclusive growth as part of the programme’s activities.
Execution of cultural events (including film, literature, and art) to showcase shared values between the EU and regional stakeholders.
Delivery of workshops for journalists, policy-makers, and civil-society leaders to enhance engagement and understanding of EU priorities.
Facilitation of academic exchanges and research collaboration with think-tanks to support policy dialogue and mutual understanding.
Establishment of a consolidated stakeholder network for sustained policy dialogue between the EU and regional actors.
Direct engagement and benefit to over 1,000 individuals in Mexico and Central America through programme activities.

top_actors.name: European Union
top_actors.justification: The European Union is the central actor in the document: it is the financier, the policy driver, and the main subject of the outreach and partnership efforts. The programme's objectives, activities, and expected results all revolve around strengthening the EU's presence, visibility, and influence in Mexico and Central America.

top_actors.name: Organisation of Ibero-American States
top_actors.justification: The Organisation of Ibero-American States (OEI) is the implementer of the programme, responsible for executing the technical assistance and outreach activities. Its operational role is crucial for the delivery and success of the EU's objectives in the region.

top_actors.name: Civil Society Organisations
top_actors.justification: Civil Society Organisations are a key target group and direct beneficiaries of the programme. They are central to the outreach, engagement, and trust-building activities, and their involvement is essential for achieving the project's goals of mutual understanding and sustained policy dialogue.

top_themes.name: Bi-regional Cooperation
top_themes.justification: The central focus of the document is the EU's Policy and Outreach Partnership Programme, which is fundamentally about strengthening cooperation and partnerships between the EU and Mexico/Central America. The majority of the content, including objectives, activities, and expected results, revolves around building and consolidating these bi-regional relationships. This theme is directly tied to the project's main message, strategic objectives, and SDG 17 (Partnerships).

top_themes.name: Digital & Technological Partnerships
top_themes.justification: Digital transformation and technological collaboration are highlighted as key thematic areas for engagement (e.g., forums on digital transformation). While not the sole focus, these partnerships are strategically important for modernizing cooperation and are specifically mentioned among the illustrative activities, making them a significant subtheme within the broader cooperation framework.

top_themes.name: Cultural Diplomacy & Outreach
top_themes.justification: Cultural events, academic exchanges, and public-diplomacy activities are repeatedly referenced as means to build mutual trust, increase EU visibility, and project shared values. These activities are essential to achieving the programme's objectives and are given substantial attention in the document, making this theme highly relevant.
